tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind the backdrop glows and every glass panel. Warm paper-white in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Opaque ground for content that must not be translucent (menus, dialogs, table bodies). Floating panels use glass instead.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, table headers, row hover, search fields and wells inside a card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Translucent hairlines: dividers, table row rules, the sidebar rule. Cards no longer have a border; they are separated by glass and shadow. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons (3:1 on surface and paper in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on paper, surface, glass and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (authors, timestamps, meta) on paper, surface, glass and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Deep crimson. The dark end of every brand gradient; solid brand fills such as the alert count. Never used to mean an error.

tokens.name: brand-bright
tokens.usage: The light end of the brand gradient (primary button, current nav item, monogram, hero mark): linear-gradient(135deg, brand-bright, brand).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills. The primary button hover shifts the gradient to brand → brand-hover.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand, brand-bright and brand-hover fills, including the gradients.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Crimson text: links, 'See all', selected tab labels, on paper, surface and glass.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for a selected row, an active filter chip, ghost-button hover. Text on it is ink or brand-text.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Default frosted fill of floating panels, stat tiles and the sidebar. Always combined with backdrop blur (blur-glass) and shadow-float.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: More opaque glass: secondary and danger buttons, badges and rings that must stay legible over the backdrop, the end stop of CTA gradients.

tokens.name: glass-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of glass-strong controls.

tokens.name: glow-rose
tokens.usage: Blurred backdrop blob (top left) and the default stat tile glow.

tokens.name: glow-gold
tokens.usage: Blurred backdrop blob (right), gold stat tile glow and the gold bands on book covers.

tokens.name: glow-blush
tokens.usage: Blurred backdrop blob (bottom centre).

tokens.name: glow-red
tokens.usage: Alert stat tile glow and the light end of ranked-list bars.

tokens.name: glow-teal
tokens.usage: Teal (available, returned) stat tile glow.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Wash over the blurred bookshelf so text on top stays readable. Same hue as paper.

tokens.name: scrim-strong
tokens.usage: Left edge of the horizontal scrim, strongest behind page titles.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar background: a frosted glass panel floating beside the content (blur 24px), no longer an opaque binding.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink
tokens.usage: Nav labels on the glass sidebar. Dark in light theme, light in dark theme.

tokens.name: sidebar-muted
tokens.usage: Section labels, nav icons and counts on the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a nav item. The current page instead gets the brand gradient with on-brand text and shadow-brand.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Foil accent: small marks only. A mark colour, not a text colour on paper.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue and destructive states: text and icons on surface, glass, paper and danger-soft. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Overdue badge, overdue alert rows and the overdue CTA gradient.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid danger fill (5.7:1 in light, 6.8:1 in dark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due soon: text and icons on surface, glass, paper and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Due soon badge and the gold stat tile tint.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Available, returned, active member: text and icons on surface, glass, paper and success-soft. Teal, so it never relies on red-green alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Available and Returned badges and the teal stat tile tint.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of Lost, Damaged and Withdrawn badges (text: ink-muted).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Meets 3:1 on paper, surface and glass in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The library name in the dashboard hero. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Book titles, member names, card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Returned 2 days late by Ana Popescu.
styles.usage: Default UI text, table cells, form values.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Authors, book numbers, timestamps; colour ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: section eyebrows, 'See all', table headers, badge text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside rows and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in lists and tables.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; bottom padding of panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between dashboard sections; page gutter; panel and sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Header padding; space above a section title.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Generous breaks around the page hero.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large page breaks only.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Book cover thumbnails, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List rows on hover.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Nav items, CTA tiles, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Glass surfaces and stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Large floating panels: the sidebar, the activity feed and report panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, search fields, avatars, the hero mark and the round Lend/Return button.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of shadow-float. New work uses shadow-float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating glass surfaces: stat tiles, the sidebar, secondary buttons. Soft, wide and tinted warm in light theme.

tokens.name: shadow-float-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels that sit highest: the main report and activity panels.

tokens.name: shadow-brand
tokens.usage: Crimson glow under every brand-gradient element: primary button, current nav item, monogram, hero mark.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: The sticky checkout bar along the bottom.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of glass surfaces, used as blur(var(--blur-glass)) saturate(1.2). The sidebar uses 24px; glass buttons and bars use 16px.
